title: FSAN: Flow State Attention Network for Aerodynamic Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.06660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate aerodynamic prediction is critical for designing fuel-efficient and safe transportation systems such as aircraft and automobiles, yet traditional computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations remain computationally expensive and expertise-intensive, severely limiting their use in iterative design and real-time analysis. Existing deep learning surrogates suffer from two major limitations: (i) they are evaluated on datasets with narrow flow-condition ranges, leaving their performance under complex flow conditions undemonstrated; (ii) they treat global flow conditions as a single vector injected uniformly across all surface points, ignoring that different geometric regions experience distinct local flow phenomena, which degrades prediction accuracy under complex flow conditions. translated_title: FSAN：用于空气动力学预测的流动状态注意力网络
translated_abstract: 准确的空气动力学预测对于设计节能且安全的交通系统（如飞机和汽车）至关重要，然而传统的计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟计算成本高昂且依赖专业知识，严重限制了其在迭代设计和实时分析中的应用。现有的深度学习代理模型存在两大局限：（i）它们是在流动条件范围狭窄的数据集上进行评估的，其在复杂流动条件下的性能尚未得到验证；（ii）它们将全局流动条件视为单一向量，均匀地注入到所有表面点上，忽略了不同几何区域会经历不同的局部流动现象，从而在复杂流动条件下降低了预测精度。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了流动状态注意力网络（FSAN）。FSAN 分别对点云和流动条件进行编码，然后将……
tldr: 提出流动状态注意力网络（FSAN），通过分别编码点云与流动条件以捕捉不同几何区域的局部流动现象，从而在复杂流动条件下实现更准确的空气动力学预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Flow State Attention Network (FSAN), which separately encodes point clouds and flow conditions to capture distinct local flow phenomena across geometric regions, enabling more accurate aerodynamic prediction under complex flow conditions.
